description: Interface golden conformance (FORGE-056): every non-Effect interface is a projection of the same contracts the runtime enforces. Each entry names the artifact, the test that certifies it, and the profiles it was run against. Discovery is compatibility metadata, never deployment trust: a digest mismatch routes to `forge compat`.

discovery.artifact: GET /forge/discovery (forge-discovery/1: package, edition, profile, buildHash, digests, contracts.version, features, auth, links, operation counts)
discovery.rule: bounded and authenticated; undeclared operations stay hidden; hash mismatch triggers compatibility evaluation, not equivalence

rules: remote $ref only through --pin URL=FILE[@SHA256]; never fetched
server/callback hosts must be public and allow-listed; private/loopback/link-local/metadata refused
arrays, unions, binary media, header/cookie and array query parameters are reported unsupported, never approximated silently
identifier-like fields stay text and are listed in FOREIGN_IDS.md

scenario: packages/interfaces/test/sdk-conformance.test.ts STEPS (create, get, enum, patch-null, patch-absent, stale, site, order, transition, job, page, missing) kept in lockstep with sdk-python/conformance.py and sdk-go/cmd/conformance
